title: Conjecture on the sign of the $M_4$ and power-mean difference
statement:
Let $M_4$ be the mean defined in the paper, let $B_p$ and $B_q$ be power means, and let $\mathcal{R}(B_p,M_4,B_q)$ denote their associated stabilizing mean. Set

$$
p=3-2q,\qquad q=\frac12(3\pm\sqrt{21}).
$$

**Sign conjecture.** Then

$$
M_4-\mathcal{R}(B_p,M_4,B_q)>0.
$$

The claim records the positive sign obtained from the asymptotic expansion relevant to stabilizability of $M_4$ by power means. The source provides no resolution evidence, so the conjecture remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.13618

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of May 2024).
source_name: Lenka Mihoković and Mustapha Raïssouli, “Results on comparison and sub/super-stabilizability of some new means”, arXiv:2405.13618 (2024).
